column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 to CVE and NIST NVD Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Schema-level mappings between ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Risk and Asset classes and the CVE record schema (cve:) plus the NIST National Vulnerability Database enrichment schema (nvd:). Combined in one file because NVD entries are CVE records enriched with CVSS, CWE references and CPE applicability statements. Enables vulnerability-management workflows (Annex A 8.8) to consume CVE/NVD feeds.

column10: Risk record corresponds to a CVE record when arising from a published vulnerability
